Assert on bytes, at multiple lengths, over 0x00–0xFF.\n1032\t\n1033\t### 14.3 Conformance vectors\n1034\t\n1035\tShip as fixtures, because they are what a third-party implementation would need:\n1036\t\n1037\t- `(streamId, blockIndex, seq) → index set` — bit-exact, pinning the PRNG (I3)\n1038\t- Header encode/decode round-trip at every field boundary\n1039\t- Beacon encode/decode including absent optional fields\n1040\t- Repair-code round-trip, including a deliberately mistyped code\n1041\t- A **two-realm test**: the same built app in two contexts, one sending, one receiving —\n1042\t  the only test that actually verifies the \"both roles, one page\" constraint\n1043\t\n1044\t### 14.4 The no-network assertion\n1045\t\n1046\tCI MUST fail the build if the running app issues **any** network request after load —\n1047\tincluding the lazy WASM fetch described in §6.5, which is the most likely violation and\n1048\tdoes not occur until the first decode, so **the assertion must exercise a decode**\n1049\t(intercept `fetch`/`XHR`/`WebSocket`/`EventSource`/`Image`; fail on any call). This is the\n1050\texecutable form of T7 and of concept.md constraint 1.\n1051\t\n1052\t### 14.5 Quality gates\n1053\t\n1054\t| Gate | Requirement |\n1055\t|---|---|\n1056\t| **G1** | Typecheck, lint, unit, property, stub-camera all green |\n1057\t| **G2** | No network requests (§14.4) |\n1058\t| **G3** | Bundle-size budget not exceeded; dependencies pinned to exact versions, no post-install scripts (T5) |\n1059\t| **G4** | Simulation assertions for D5/D6/D25 pass (I2), **at the adopted K** |\n1060\t| **G5** | Memory budget (I6a) holds on T-scale. **Runs nightly**, so it gates the nightly build, not each commit — see the cadence note below |\n1061\t| **G6** | Throughput budgets (§13.1) hold on T-physical-rig — release only |\n1062\t| **G7** | `python3 docs/research/sim/ge_cost_model.py --check` passes — **the plan's §3.1/§4 numbers match what the model computes**. This exists because every critical defect found in review was a bookkeeping failure attached to correct reasoning; making the numbers executable removes the class |\n1063\t\n1064\t**All-gates-same-commit:** G1–G4 and **G7** MUST pass on the *same* commit — these are\n1065\tfast. G5 is nightly and gates the nightly build; G6 is release-only. Phase 0's exit criteria are\n**not** met: see §17.2.\n\n### Revision history\n\n| Date | Change | Consumed |\n|---|---|---|\n| 2026-07-31 | Initial plan: modulation, fountain code, framing, phases | 6 research threads |\n| 2026-07-31 | Link adaptation folded in (D16–D18) | `link-adaptation.md` |\n| 2026-07-31 | **Rewritten around the multi-GB objective** — block layer, streaming, resume | — |\n| 2026-07-31 | Ideation run: 7 roadmap items adopted (§17) | `ideas-ledger.md` |\n| 2026-07-31 | **Phase 0.5 spike run (S1/S2/S3 + thermal)**; §2 units, R11, D27, E17 split, §13.1 measured column, §6.4 ROI caveat, Stage 3 reframed as frame-rate.
